parts.text: By reference to heating effect, explain what is meant by the root-mean-square (r.m.s.) value of an alternating current.

parts.label: (b)
(b)(i)
parts.text: Use Fig. 10.1 to determine the peak value and the r.m.s. value of the current $I_1$.

parts.label: (c)
parts.part_stem:
The variation with time $t$ of the supply voltage $V$ to a house is given by the expression

$$V = 240 \sin kt$$

where $V$ is in volts, $t$ is in seconds and $k$ is a constant with unit $\text{rad s}^{-1}$.

parts.label: (c)(i)
parts.text:
The frequency of the supply voltage is $50\text{ Hz}$.

Determine $k$ to two significant figures.

parts.label: (c)(ii)
parts.text:
The supply voltage is applied to a heater. The mean power of the heater is $3.2\text{ kW}$.

Calculate the resistance of the heater.
